title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-08-29
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with clear audio captures a brilliant early Dead show highlighted by an epic 30‑minute Lovelight and strong performances of Easy Wind, High Time, New Orleans/Searchin' and Working Man’s material.
ai_review.review: The set is praised for its musical firepower – Jerry’s bluesy Easy Wind, soaring organ on High Time, a marathon 30‑minute Lovelight and solid renditions of the Working Man’s Dead era. The Miller soundboard source provides good, clean sound with no notable flaws, making the historic performance an enjoyable listen.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave high marks (4‑5 stars) and highlighted strong musical moments; recording is described as good sound quality from a soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced Miller soundboard capture; reviewers note good sound quality with no significant issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early numbers are described as tentative and sloppy, but the band quickly finds its stride, delivering a brilliant second half highlighted by an extended Lovelight and tight ensemble playing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Greases up his blues chops on Easy Wind; voice sounds a bit forced on Dire Wolf.
band_member_comments.Keys: Cool vibrato on organ during High Time noted by reviewers.
